title: Last cycle's plan as a warm start

cases.says: a retired project, and a start year this cycle's window no longer allows, are left out of the carried plan
the repaired start breaks no rule, the hint carries exactly its starts, and the hinted solve reaches the same optimum as the plain one
the hint is complete: every start variable gets a value, 0 for the starts the plan does not use
the project dropped first is the one with the least NPV per $k, not the least NPV
a project that spends only in years within budget is kept, however little it is worth
a must-do stays even when it is worth the least per $k
dropping a parent drops its child too, so the start breaks no precedence row
a child whose parent has no start variable this cycle is not carried either
a parent whose child is a must-do is never dropped, so the must-do keeps its start

origin.section: A Warm Start Is Last Cycle's Plan, Repaired and Handed Over as a Hint
